fields.description: Slot 0 two-digit file counter (0-99); loader clamps values >99 to 3, file-select screen renders it as tens+ones decimal digits.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 1 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 into EWRAM save struct +0x14 (clamp '>99 -> 3'); FUN_08047efc renders it via FUN_08051818/FUN_08051890 div/mod 10. Save offset = 1*8+0 = 8.
fields.name: slot0_file_counter

fields.description: Slot 0 progress tag byte; selects file-select tile variants together with world/stage bytes.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 1 byte 1 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x17; FUN_08047efc tests it for tile indices 0x27 vs 0x2d. Save offset = 1*8+1 = 9.
fields.name: slot0_progress_tag_a

fields.description: Slot 0 stage/sub-area byte; compared against 9 and 10 to pick file-select tile layout.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 1 byte 2 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x1a; FUN_08047efc branches on values 9 (0x09) and 10 (0x0a). Save offset = 1*8+2 = 10.
fields.name: slot0_stage_id

fields.description: Slot 0 world/area selector byte; 0 and 7 share one tile branch, 1 and 2 select others.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 1 byte 3 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x1d; FUN_08047efc branches on values 0, 7, 1, 2. Save offset = 1*8+3 = 11.
fields.name: slot0_world_id

fields.description: Slot 0 progress tag byte; gated through mod-3 check to select alternate tile branch.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 1 byte 4 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x20; FUN_08047efc applies FUN_08051890(x,3) with branches on 0/1/2. Save offset = 1*8+4 = 12.
fields.name: slot0_progress_tag_b

fields.description: Slot 0 emblem/rank icon byte: 0 hides the icon, 1-5 draw icon tiles, >=6 draws the special icon and sets the 0x80 completion flag at struct +0x29.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 6 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x23 (flag 0 vs 0x80 at +0x29 on '<6' test); FUN_08047efc draws tile 0x2d+id or 0x32. Save offset = 6*8+0 = 48.
fields.name: slot0_emblem_id

fields.description: Slot 1 two-digit file counter (0-99); same loader clamp and decimal rendering as slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 loop iteration 1 (base block 19) reads EEPROM block 20 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x14+1; FUN_08047efc renders slot index 1 the same way. Save offset = 20*8+0 = 160.
fields.name: slot1_file_counter

fields.description: Slot 1 emblem/rank icon byte, same semantics as slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 loop iteration 1 reads EEPROM block 25 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x23+1; FUN_08047efc consumes it for slot index 1. Save offset = 25*8+0 = 200.
fields.name: slot1_emblem_id

fields.description: Slot 2 two-digit file counter (0-99); same loader clamp and decimal rendering as slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 loop iteration 2 (base block 38) reads EEPROM block 39 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x14+2; FUN_08047efc renders slot index 2 the same way. Save offset = 39*8+0 = 312.
fields.name: slot2_file_counter

fields.description: Slot 2 emblem/rank icon byte, same semantics as slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 loop iteration 2 reads EEPROM block 44 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 into save struct +0x23+2; FUN_08047efc consumes it for slot index 2. Save offset = 44*8+0 = 352.
fields.name: slot2_emblem_id

fields.description: Global 3-way option (valid values 0-2); loader resets it to 0 when the stored byte exceeds 2.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039b64 reads EEPROM block 0x39 byte 0 via FUN_080513b8 and stores it to global struct +0x12, resetting to 0 when '>2'; invalid-slot path writes default 0 via FUN_08051634. Save offset = 57*8+0 = 456.
fields.name: global_option
